userId.description: must be an objectId and is required

workoutItemId.description: must be an objectId and is required

workoutItemType.description: type of the workout item, must be either 'exercise' or 'superset' and is required

workoutDayId.description: must be an objectId and is required, referencing the workout day

workoutPlanId.description: must be an objectId and is required, referencing the workout plan

completed.description: boolean indicating if the workout item has been completed
